name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not with a wrench but with a paintbrush. After years as a custom car painter in Montreal, specializing in airbrush murals and intricate designs, he found himself drawn to the high-octane world of racing. The precision and artistry required in automotive paintwork translated surprisingly well to the demands of a racing team, where durability and weight are as crucial as aesthetics.

He joined United Autosports a decade ago, bringing a fresh perspective to their paint shop. Jean-Pierre's pragmatic approach ensures every paint job meets the highest standards, not just in appearance but in performance. He meticulously analyzes paint composition and application techniques to minimize weight and maximize aerodynamic efficiency. His experience allows him to quickly diagnose and solve paint-related issues, minimizing delays and keeping the cars looking their best on the track.

Jean-Pierre's distinctive edge lies in his ability to blend artistic flair with technical precision. He understands that a race car's paint job is more than just a cosmetic detail; it's an integral part of its overall performance. This holistic view, combined with his unwavering commitment to quality, makes him an invaluable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Jean-Pierre is of average height, with a sturdy build and hands that show years of careful work.

quirks: Always wears a beret in the paint shop, claiming it keeps the fumes away.
Insists on using only French-made masking tape.
Often hums jazz tunes while working, claiming it helps him focus.
